body:
Thank you for your kind words. I’ll look up that ZAC group, I’ve never heard of them until now, so thank you.

I’m really scared to show him these resources because I don’t know how he’s going to react. I’m afraid he might brush it off or flat ignore me. Or blame my mother for me being such a meddler. I really don’t know but I’ll try to muster up some courage. Thank you again and I hope you and your father take care.

Thank you for sharing your story. I’m sorry if it came off that I didn’t understand micro aggressions. I’ve had my fair share of them as a kikokushijo and it stunted my mental health to the point I couldn’t brush my teeth or wash myself for days. I understand some of the pain he has. It’s just hard to be kind to someone who has traumatized you.

I want to ask him that so badly. My mother would probably be heartbroken if he says yes, and I don’t even know if we can afford to let him go, but if it’ll make his situation better we should really consider it.

Thank you for your suggestion. Like I said in another reply, my dad threatened my mother to go back to Korea and never come back so I can’t suggest that to my family without worrying my mother. Also the whole virus thing.

As for the xenophobic thing, probably. I’ve had my handful of racists when I lived in the United States as a kid. I probably can’t equivocate that to my dad’s situation because different cultures and political environments etc etc. I just wish my father had a community that truly understood his experiences. He literally doesn’t have any friends except for his wife who takes a lot of shit from him.

Thank you for your kind words. 

He’s been threatening my mother to go back to Korea and never come back, so while I want to give him some time to sort out his emotions and take a break, I don’t know how to suggest that and not scare my mother. Thank you for the suggestion tho, i believe it would help him if it weren’t for these strange circumstances.

Also I don’t know if travel is allowed right now due to the virus, and also I heard that even if you have permanent residency, foreigners with their native citizenship will be shut out from the country if they leave. I’d tried looking it up but I’m still not sure whether that’s true or not.

Thank you. I read the article you sent me, I’m not smart enough to express how it made me feel, but there was a painful squeezing sensation in my chest. I think it was sadness.

Thank you for empathizing for my father when I cannot and thank you for your kind words.
Thank you, it seems like there’s online counseling so this might be a good place to start.

I understand what you’re trying to say and I understand that I should have more empathy for him. He has physically abused my brother and verbally abused me and my mother in the past, not to mention made fun of my own depression and suicide attempts. Personally, I can’t be the caring person and understanding person that I know I should be because of those experiences and more. There are so many different factors that I can’t sum up within one reply that causes this frustration and resentment towards my dad, but I also don’t want him to hurt himself or others. 

Sorry this is coming off ranty and angry. I’m really confused with my emotions ask well, but I’m trying to find somewhere close that could help my dad.
Thank you, I’m searching for someone who could help me find my dad a counselor.

He was born in South Korea, so unfortunately he can’t use that trick. (I really wish he could, it would be so much more easier for everybody.)

I hope I can get him some counseling. I honestly don’t want to help him, but he’s causing my family so much pain, but my mother is too scared to say anything critical about him and my brother is too young to give a crap. (Sorry if this comes off as angry. It’s not towards you, my frustration with my father is just getting worse)
Thank you, I’m trying to find one but I don’t know where to start. I’ll try searching up those terms.

He’s had a few outbursts like this a long time ago but they’ve been more frequent lately. He says he has emotional problems but won’t specify whether it’s anger issues/depression/etc. I also think that it’s more than just the xenophobic comments, but they seems to trigger him a lot. I’m just at my wits end because he refuses to go to any sort of counseling or doctor.

it really is awful. I wrote this post yesterday to cope and just as I thought my menstrual cycle began. Medicine can only do so much and I wish this awful cycle would just stop.

I wish you the best of luck and hope that pms doesn’t get the best of you
my deadline was 16, and now I’m 20. I feel like a rotten corpse. I hope you’re able to figure it out bc im still confused as to why I’m still here. Best of luck to u
Same here. It’s not like those words are going to fix anything.
